ctx.x: You also mentioned the Walton School, which was (inaudible) school. Was that (inaudible)?

Dennison, Texas. It was located in the section of Dennison that was known as Rock Hill and as a matter of fact, a whole lot of people that you might know came from Rock Hill, like President Eisenhower. He used to be down there and he used to borrow some of my uncle's dogs to hunt with when (unintelligible). They were pecan pickers.
